name: Chaos Queen Ryouko Story #2 Sugiura Kasumi Hen
original_name: カオスQUEEN遼子 STORY#2 杉浦夏澄編
source:
Ryouko's dream is interrupted by her assistant who is pursued by persistent scientist girl. Ryouko does not mind giving her love consultation and two strong personalities clash.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-october-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]

辽子的梦被助手打断了，他正被一个执着的女科学家追赶。辽子不介意给她进行恋爱咨询，两个强势的个性发生了碰撞。
